paite: Deihtakte aw, kha napeuh gingta kei un, himahleh khate Pathian a kipan ahi uhiam hilou chih chian un; khovel a zawlnei taklou tampi ana pawt tak ziak un.
heading: Khate Chian Un

paite: Hiai ah Pathian Kha na thei ding uh, bang kha peuh Jesu Khrist, sa in ahong pai chih gum tuh Pathian a kipan ahi.
Bang kha peuh Jesu gum lou Pathian a kipan ahi kei; huai tuh Khrist doumi kha, hong pai ding na zak uh ahi; tu in khovel ah a-om khinta hi.
Naute aw, Pathian a kipan na hi ua, tuate na zouta uhi; noumau a om khovel a om sang a athupi zawk ziak in.
Amau khovel a ahi ua; huaiziak in khovel a bang in apau ua, khovel in athu uh angaikhia hi.
Eite Pathian a kipan i hi ua, Pathian thei mite'n i thu angaikhe zel uhi; Pathian a kipan lou mite'n bel i thu angaikhe kei uhi. Hiai ah thutak Kha leh thutak lou kha i thei uhi.
Deihtakte aw, i ki-ittuah chiat ding uh; itna zaw Pathian a suak ahi ngal a, michih itna nei peuhmah Pathian a suak ahi khin ua, Pathian athei lai uhi.
heading: Pathian Itna Ahi

paite: Itna nei lou in Pathian athei kei; Pathian itna ahih ziak in.
Hiai ah Pathian itna i tung uah ahong langta hi, amah ziak a i hintheihna ding a Pathian in a Tapa neihsun khovel a ahon sawlna ah.
Hiai ah itna a-om, eite'n Pathian i it uh ka chi ahi kei, ama'n ahon it a, i khelhnate thuphatawina ding in, a Tapa ahon sawl ka chi zaw hi.
Deihtakte aw, Pathian in huchi tel a ahon itleh eite leng i ki-ittuah chiat ding uh ahi.
Kuamah in chik lai mah in Pathian amu ngei kei hi. I ki-ittuah chiat uleh ei ah Pathian a-om gige dia, a-itna leng eite sung ah akim lai ding hi.
heading: Itna Pathian Muhna Ahi

paite: Amah ah i om gige chih leh amah eite sung ah a-om gige chih Kha a hon piak tak ziak in hiai ah i thei hi.
Huan Pa in Tapa khovel Hondampa hihna nei in ahon sawl chih i muta ua, i theisak uhi.
Kuapeuh Jesu Pathian Tapa ahi chi a gum amah ah Pathian a-om gige a, amah leng Pathian ah a-om gige hi.
Pathian in eite a ding in itna anei chih i theita ua, i gingta lai uhi. Pathian itna ahi; itna a om gige mi Pathian ah a-om a, Pathian leng amah ah a-om hi.
heading: Itna Buchinna

paite: Hiai ah i tung uah itna akimta, vaihawm ni a ding a lau lou a i omtheihna ah; amah om bang a khovel a i om ziak in.
Itna ah launa a-om kei, itna kim in lauhna adelhkhe zaw zel hi, lauhna in gawtna ahon ngaihtuahsak; alaumi peuhmah itna ah abukim nai kei hi.
Ama'n ahon it masak ziak in i it uhi.
heading: Pathian Itna Leh Sanggamte Itna

paite: Mi'n, "Pathian ka it," chi in a-unau ho taleh amah zuauthei ahi; a-unau amuhsa bawn a-it kei in, Pathian amuh ngei louhpi bangchi in a-it thei dia?
Amah kiang a kipan in hiai thupiak i nei uhi, kuapeuh in Pathian a-itleh a-unau leng a-it sam ding chihna ahi.
